name: Dosulepin
metabolism: Dosulepin is readily absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract and extensively broken down in the liver. Metabolites include northiaden, dosulepin-S-oxide and northiaden-S-oxide. It is excreted in the urine (50-60%), mainly as metabolites, and appreciably in the faeces (15-40%), most of which is first excreted in the bile. A half-life of about 50 hours has been reported for dosulepin and its metabolites. Dosulepin has been found in breast milk.
summary: Dosulepin (dothiepin) is a tricyclic antidepressant used to treat depression. Its use has declined because of its toxicity in overdose.
